description: This file defines a React component named Popover that manages popover positioning, orientation, and responsive behavior (mobile vs desktop). It includes context for nested popovers, hooks for media queries and Android back button handling, and renders different components based on screen size.

methods.description: Custom hook to register and unregister this popover with its parent via React context.
